errorBreakdown.description: Direction correct but breakout/reversal target completed 8-15 minutes after horizon expiry (especially in 5m/15m windows).
Micro sweep in 5m candle reversed immediately due to lack of higher-timeframe order flow absorption.
Intra-hour volatility burst or sudden BTC dominance surge during open trade.
Multi-candle indicator confirmation lag eating up the initial 50% of the 5m/15m move.
Disagreement between 15m delta absorption and 1h trend-following EMAs.
Bid-ask spread slippage and thin orderbook depth triggering premature invalidation.
Static Fibonacci/RSI threshold sensitivity collapsing on volatile mid-caps.
Exchange API micro-delays and unexplained tick anomalies.
